name: William Warrner
powers: A sharp eye, a magnifying glass and a field notebook. Inspector Billy is a nickname, not a police rank. No supernatural abilities confirmed.
personality: Quiet, observant, paranoid and tenacious. No detail is too small.
relationships: Former schoolmate of Daniel Orkleson. Their friendship collapsed over Daniel’s unethical experiments; Billy helped expose them. His investigation will eventually lead to Seth.
appearances: Chapter 6: An Old Friend with New Lies
quote: Some people see problems. I see clues.
appearance: A short, stocky older man of Daniel Orkleson’s generation, with graying hair and sideburns, a lined face, a plaid deerstalker and a high-collared tan trench coat.
